description: #53: uploads the issue's EPUB to the xteink library and queues it for the reader. base_url is spark's loopback (xteink runs on spark): the action runs where the actor lives (machine spark); on another machine set xteink's LAN address. The device id is not shipped: it is the newspaper_device variable (GET /api/devices). The xtk_ key is the operator's, stored in grant as XTEINK_PUSH_API_KEY.
name: Daily newspaper: Xteink library
